question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's stricter requester-route matching for ACP/subagent completion delivery evidence before counting a completion as visibly delivered?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes when existing completion handoffs are credited as delivered versus retried or failed for threaded/channel targets.

options.title: Accept stricter route proof
options.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping exact target matching for threaded/channel completion delivery while preserving the documented non-threaded compatibility paths.

options.title: Narrow to generated media only
options.body: Ask the contributor to split the patch down to the generated-media wrong-target fallback path and leave broader completion delivery evidence semantics for a separate design review.

options.title: Hold for delivery design
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve it together with adjacent subagent visible-delivery work so requester wake, visible failure, and target matching share one contract.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter route proof
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping exact target matching for threaded/channel completion delivery while preserving the documented non-threaded compatibility paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest source-history signal on the subagent announce delivery path and adjacent routing refactors.
